subject: Stakeholder orchestration — demo readout & legal checks
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Taylor Reed <taylor@orchardtech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder orchestration — demo readout & legal checks

Hi Taylor — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Recap: You’re prioritizing a mid-June pilot for the recommendations engine. Primary success criteria are latency under 350ms p95 and end-to-end cost per inference target.
- Next meeting: technical deep-dive / demo where we show a small sandbox of the model and discuss SSO/SCIM, retention, and dev ops integration.
- Stakeholders to include: product, platform, security + your procurement/legal for contracting questions.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Jun 8, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Jun 9, 14:00–15:00
- Thu Jun 10, 09:00–10:00

I’ve attached a short MVP demo agenda and our SOC 2 summary for your security/ legal review (attachments: MVP-demo-agenda.docx; SOC2-summary.pdf). Can you confirm which slot works and the right procurement + legal contacts to invite?

Cc’ing Marissa (solutions engineer) and Sean (account lead) to join the demo. Marissa — can you prepare a short checklist for pre-demo infra access (SSO, sample data, any IP allowlist)?

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: MVP-demo-agenda.docx (stub), SOC2-summary.pdf (stub)

Kimberly — thanks for the clear recap. Wed Jun 9, 14:00–15:00 PT works best for our team. I’m looping in our procurement and legal contacts (procurement@orchardtech.com; legal@orchardtech.com) and copying Alejandra (platform lead) so she can confirm technical attendees.

Two asks ahead of the demo:
1) Can you include a short section on network/topology and any egress considerations (we’re a multi-cloud environment)?
2) What does Redwood require for SSO (SAML/SCIM)? We’ll confirm sample data availability after internal sign-off.

I’ll wait for Marissa and Kimberly to confirm the invite and any pre-demo artifacts.

—Taylor
Director of Product
Orchard Technologies

Thanks Taylor — wed Jun 9, 14:00 PT is locked on our side. We’ll cover network topology and egress in the demo (15–20 minute technical segment) and Marissa will run the sandbox walkthrough.

Rishi (cc’d) is our security/product infra lead; Rishi — can you prepare a 5–7 slide summary addressing SSO (SAML + SCIM support), encryption at rest, and retention defaults? Also flag any firewall whitelisting / IP ranges we need to provide.

Kimberly — I’ll draft a short pre-demo checklist and share in next email.

Cheers,
Marissa

Hi Kimberly — procurement here. We need two items ahead of internal approvals: 
1) A preliminary cost estimate for the pilot (monthly committed vs burst pricing, token estimates if applicable).
2) A completed procurement intake spreadsheet (attached: orchard_procurement_form.xlsx).

Please note our buying timeline: decision window is roughly Jun 20–30. Also include any standard SOW/terms we typically negotiate (we prefer to review a redline-ready contract or link to a sample).

We’ll also expect a DocuSign agreement for initial trial terms (if available).

Thanks,
